Synthesized across cross-platform AI collaboration ecosystems (Google, Meta, and auxiliary analytical tools).
No capsular serotypes. Toxin gene tox+ vs tox-.
DT itself; source of CRM197 mutant.
Links to Pneumococcal 19F, Menactra DT, Hib-DT, Typhoid Vi-DT.
Links to Pneumococcal 18C, MenQuadfi TT, Hib-TT, Typhoid Vi-TT.
Distinct repeat units (e.g., 19F phosphodiester bridge, 6A/6B ribitol-P).
CRM197 (Prevnar, Pneumosil), TT (18C), DT (19F), Protein D.
Unites Diphtheria, Tetanus, NTHi, and Meningococcal carriers into a single network.
Serogroups A, B, C, W, Y, X based on capsular polysaccharides.
Group A (ManNAc-1-P), Group C/W/Y (sialic acid variations).
Shares identical carrier footprint with Pneumococcal and Hib vaccines.
Serotypes a–f (Type b most invasive; NTHi non-typeable).
Shares TT with pneumococcal 18C and meningococcal ACWY; Protein D links to NTHi.
Vi capsular antigen positive, O9, H:d.
Parallels pneumococcal and meningococcal conjugate design via TT/CRM197.
Serotypes Ia, Ib, II, III, IV, V (sialic acid-based).
CRM197 (in investigational GBS6), TT, native proteins.
Shares sialic acid chemistry with Meningococcal B/C and CRM197 carrier architecture.
Bridges enteric lipopolysaccharides to classical tetanus and diphtheria carriers.
Encapsulated yeast; Glucuronoxylomannan (GXM) capsule with mannose backbone.
No licensed human vaccine; investigational GXM-TT, GXM-DT, GXM-CRM197.
Proves fungal capsules use identical chemistry and carrier logic to bacteria.
Fungal cell wall mannan, beta-glucan, galactomannan, Als3 adhesin.
Investigational (NDV-3A Als3-based, PEV7 Sap2); CRM197 in trials.
Demonstrates structural parallels between fungal wall polysaccharides and bacterial antigens.
RNA enveloped; Hemagglutinin (HA) and Neuraminidase (NA) glycoproteins.
IIV (Inactivated), LAIV (Live), Flublok (Recombinant). No toxoid carrier.
Contrasts polysaccharide serotypes with viral surface glycoproteins.
Small nonenveloped DNA; L1 major capsid protein Virus-Like Particles (VLPs).
Gardasil 4, Gardasil 9, Cervarix. Self-assembling VLP (no carrier).
Genotype numbers parallel bacterial serotypes via distinct capsid divergence.
Diphtheria, Tetanus, Pertussis (+/- Polio, Hib, HepB in Pediarix/Pentacel/Infanrix hexa)
Diphtheria toxoid (DT) and Tetanus toxoid (TT) acting as disease antigens and universal carrier backbones.

Tri- and quadrivalent live-attenuated viral strains (pioneered by Maurice Hilleman, 1971).
Combined inactivated viral and recombinant viral subunit platform.
DT, TT, and CRM197 convert T-independent polysaccharides into T-dependent neoantigens.
Pre-existing anti-carrier immunity can accelerate clearance or crowd out nascent B-cell activation, managed via carrier diversification (e.g., Protein D, OMPC).
Homologous machinery (wzx/wzy in bacteria, CAP genes in fungi) governs capsule assembly across kingdoms.
